name: Kujou Satsuki
source: The president of the student council at Fujisawa academy. Class 3-B. He is perfect at everything and strict with himself. Kujo is respected for always taking everything and everyone around him into consideration. However, he is also overconfident and jumps to conclusions. Kujo is Mikoto's ex-boyfriend.
